snippet.title: Blackwood: A Sétima Safra — Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Blackwood: A Sétima Safra is a psychological rural horror game developed by Noctavara Games.
Lorena Ferreira inherits her uncle's butcher shop along with a debt she has only days to repay. What begins as an attempt to keep the business running soon reveals something much older hidden beneath Blackwood — a cycle of disappearances, rituals and choices that refuse to stay buried.
Run the butcher shop. Explore the property. Follow the clues. Decide what you are willing to sacrifice.

Blackwood: A Sétima Safra — Demo
Planned for October 26, 2026 on Steam.
Developed and published by Noctavara Games.
